comment: P889 — worker-pool sizing: hostProfile is 'dedicated' (default; the server owns the box) or 'shared' (a game client/bot driver shares it, as in single-player skirmish). expectedPlayers defaults to the configured capacity (teams x maxPlayersPerTeam); set it to the real count on a small server, e.g. 20. ALLEGIANCE_HOST_PROFILE / ALLEGIANCE_EXPECTED_PLAYERS override these. See docs/PERFORMANCE.md, 'Running on your own hardware'.

credentialGuessLimits.comment: P1022 (R1 F7) — limits on guessing the game password and the admin/test-harness bearer secrets. ON by default on EVERY server; a correct credential is never slowed. 3 failed credentials retire that connection; 5 failures from one source address inside windowSeconds start a back-off that doubles up to maxLockoutSeconds. Set enabled=false for the unthrottled native behaviour. See docs/reports/R1_DISPATCH_LIMITS_P1022.md.
